entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, VeloFit agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been trying to get through for ages. Listen, I bought your stupidly expensive cycling shoes and they're a piece of junk. I want to return them right now.

I'm very sorry to hear you're not happy with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

A preference issue? Are you kidding me? These shoes gave me horrible blisters after just two rides! The cleats feel unstable and the whole thing is a disaster. I'm not paying for something that injures me. I demand a full refund.

I understand your frustration completely, and getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your order and check the return eligibility for you. Can I have your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

It's mike_smith@email.com. And don't give me the runaround. If I don't get a refund confirmation on this call, I want to speak to your manager immediately. I am this close to blasting your company all over social media.

I understand, sir. One moment while I access your account... Okay, I see your order for the VeloFit cycling shoes, delivered 17 days ago. I've reviewed our policy, and you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window.
Of course I am. So are you going to process it or are you going to waste more of my time?

I'm processing it for you right now. I have just initiated the return. A pre-paid shipping label has been sent to your email. Just pack the shoes in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off. Once our warehouse scans them in, your full refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Fine. So I will get all my money back?
Yes, a full refund for the item. You should see it in your account within 5-7 business days after we receive the item. I do apologize again for the trouble with the blisters and the cleats.
Alright, good. That's all I wanted. About time.
I'm glad I could get that sorted out for you. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. I hope you have a better rest of your day.
